nodes.description: Public pure library function factory.draw that builds the SVG string from four uint256 selections and internal helper outputs.
Internal pure helper _getShield(checkerPattern) that branches to the big or small shield renderer.
Internal pure helper _getBackground() returning the background rect markup.
Internal pure helper _getBigShield() returning the large shield markup.
Internal pure helper _getSmallShield() returning the small (checkered) shield markup.
Internal pure helper _getOutline() returning the outline rect markup.
Internal pure helper _getEights() returning the drawn '8' path markup.
uint256 background selector passed into draw and used to index the backgrounds array.
uint256 checkerPattern selector passed into draw and forwarded to _getShield.
uint256 color selector passed into draw and used to index the colors array.
uint256 eight selector passed into draw and used to index the eights array.
uint256 checkerPattern parameter of _getShield controlling the branch selection.
Fixed-size string[4] array of background CSS rules declared inside draw.
Fixed-size string[4] array of color CSS rules declared inside draw.
Fixed-size string[2] array of eight-style CSS rules declared inside draw.
Local string bg holding the selected background style concatenated into the SVG.
Local string c holding the selected color style concatenated into the SVG.
Local string e holding the selected eight style concatenated into the SVG.
Local string receiving the markup returned by _getEights().
Local string receiving the markup returned by _getOutline().
Local string receiving the markup returned by _getBackground().
Local string closing the style block and opening the image group.
Local string receiving the shield markup returned by _getShield(checkerPattern).
Local string background inside _getBackground holding the static rect markup.
Local string shield inside _getBigShield holding the large shield markup.
Local string shield inside _getSmallShield holding the checkered shield markup.
Local string outline inside _getOutline holding the outline rect markup.
Local string eight inside _getEights holding the digit path markup.
Unchecked array indexing backgrounds[background] on a string[4]; an out-of-range selector reverts, and any index arithmetic is unvalidated.
Unchecked array indexing colors[color] on a string[4]; an out-of-range selector reverts, and any index arithmetic is unvalidated.
Unchecked array indexing eights[eight] on a string[2]; an out-of-range selector reverts, and any index arithmetic is unvalidated.
